column3: NASB follows the critical text; “Impossible that the stumbling blocks not come” is rendered “It is inevitable that stumbling blocks come.”
NASB follows the critical text without “against you”; “Take heed to yourselves” is rendered “Be on your guard!”
NASB follows the critical text; the future “you will forgive” is rendered as a command.
“Add to us faith” is rendered “Increase our faith!”
NASB follows the critical text; “mustard grain” is rendered “mustard seed.”
NASB follows the critical text; “servant” is rendered “slave,” and “recline” is “sit down to eat.”
NASB renders “having girded yourself” as “properly clothe yourself.”
NASB follows the critical text without “I think not.”
NASB follows the critical text; “servants” is rendered “slaves,” and it adds “only.”
NASB renders the clause order differently (“who stood at a distance met Him”).
NASB renders the question “Were not the ten cleansed?” as “Were there not ten cleansed?”
“Has cured you” (saved) is rendered “has made you well.”
NASB renders “with careful observation” as “with signs to be observed.”
NASB follows the critical text; “in the midst of you” may also mean “within you.”
